prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1474; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the front end shows a crushed radiator support, cracked bumper cover, and a bent hood latch, all consistent with a frontal strike at low speed. The damage pattern lines up with the reported impact, and no older damage or prior repairs are evident on the panels or underlying structure. The proposed plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, hood latch, and radiator support, with painting and refinishing of the adjoining panels. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this work, and the invoices reviewed show no duplicated line items. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
